Class OptionsLots

java.lang.Object
cascadia.board.OptionsLots
public class OptionsLots extends Object
Represents a set of 4 lots in the Cascadia game, where each lot consists of a habitat and a fauna token. Provides functionalities to initialize, assign, and manage lots for players during the game.

    • givePlayerLot

      public Player givePlayerLot(Lot lot, Pioche pioche, Player player)
      Assigns a Lot to a player if they do not already have one. The selected Lot is removed from the options, and a new Lot is added to the list from the Pioche.
      Parameters:
      lot - the lot to be assigned to the player.
      pioche - the draw pile to replenish the lot options.
      player - the player who will receive the lot.
      Returns:
      the updated Player instance with the new lot assigned.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the lot is not in the list of available lots.
      NullPointerException - if any of the parameters are null.

    • ecarterToken

      public void ecarterToken(int indexLotToken, Pioche pioche)
      Discards a fauna token from a specified lot and recycles it into the pioche.
      Parameters:
      indexLotToken - the index of the lot from which to discard the token.
      pioche - the draw pile where the token will be recycled.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the index is out of range (0-3).
      NullPointerException - if the pioche is null.

    • ecarterMultipleTokens

      public void ecarterMultipleTokens(List<Integer> indexLotsTokens, Pioche pioche)
      Discards multiple fauna tokens from the specified lots and recycles them into the pioche.
      Parameters:
      indexLotsTokens - a list of indices corresponding to the lots whose tokens will be discarded.
      pioche - the draw pile where the tokens will be recycled.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the pioche is null.

    • choisirTokenAndTuile

      public Player choisirTokenAndTuile(int indexLotToken, int indexLotTuile, Player player)
      Allows a player to choose a token and a tile from the available lots and assigns them to the player. The token and habitat in the lots are then updated accordingly.
      Parameters:
      indexLotToken - the index of the lot from which to choose the fauna token.
      indexLotTuile - the index of the lot from which to choose the habitat tile.
      player - the player making the choice.
      Returns:
      the updated Player instance with the new lot assigned.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either index is out of range (0-3).
      NullPointerException - if the player is null.
